payload.explanation: FINAL run-end verdict. All four parts' end-states were measured directly via query_snapshot against their placement frames at run end: u_brown 0.0021m, u_orange 0.0021m, line_green 0.0066m, inverted_u_yellow 0.0016m from their respective placement frames, all within their contract position tolerances (0.01/0.02/0.015/0.012m). The in-hand slippage monitor (object-to-TCP offset vs. grasp-time reference, tolerance 0.02m) was armed for each part across its pick-to-place span and never fired, confirming no slip occurred, consistent with each part's small, stable final tcp-offset. The stationarity/"undisturbed objects" monitor covered the five bystanders (u_green, inverted_u_brown, hex_blue, hex_red, base2) and base1 continuously from run start, and was extended to cover each of this set's own parts once its place step closed; it never fired, and my own end-of-run query confirms every bystander and base1 sits within ~0.001m of its original resting pose (well inside the 0.02m disturbance tolerance), and every one of this assembly's own parts stayed where it was seated after its own milestone (disturbances recorded at later milestones ranged 0.0001-0.0033m, all within tolerance). One monitor_fire occurred: clamp_effort_u_brown fired at 104.84 vs its 100 threshold while inverted_u_yellow (not u_brown) was actually being gripped, because that monitor read the shared finger_joint effort channel without gating on held_object. I adjudicated this as a mis-arming, not a physical finding (u_brown was not being gripped at that moment, so its clamp limit was never actually tested against that reading), recorded no verdict for it, and immediately corrected the remaining per-part clamp monitors to gate on held_object before continuing. No other violation occurred. The workspace-observation monitor (camera-based) fired repeatedly on ordinary arm motion into/through its field of view; each fire was checked by look() or by cross-referencing bystander poses, and none corresponded to an actual unexpected object or disturbance. Steps pick_u_brown, place_approach_u_brown, pick_u_orange, place_approach_u_orange, pick_line_green, place_approach_line_green, pick_inverted_u_yellow, and place_approach_inverted_u_yellow all checked out clean (invariants only, no effects due) and are held here as part of the accumulated record. The executor's run_ended status is "completed", consistent with this independent assessment. End-state: all four parts seated within tolerance, no standing violation, no disturbed bystander or fixture. Verdict: conformant.
